description:
General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This is the Rear Drive Shaft that goes from the Transfer Case to the Rear Differential
Small 8mm Bolt Pattern
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Rear Drive Shaft – 20″ length
NOTE: These driveshafts will require work to be operable. They are an inexpensive option that’s available. May need to be balanced, require new U-Joints or even cut and re-welded to function correctly)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1988 All Models
Suzuki SJ413 1985 – 1988 All Models
